title: Fungal Bulb Rot on Onion - Sri Lanka

Header: Fungal Bulb Rot on Onion - Sri Lanka
Fusarium oxysporum f.sp. cepae In Sinhala: Luunu bulba kunuwema, In Tamil: Kumil alukal

Prevention: Proper land preparation to improve drainage system.
Proper spacing & plant density (10 cm x 10cm).
Prevent the entry of water from infected field making ridges surrounding the plots.
Monitoring: Regular field visits - observe fungal mycelium growth, close monitoring of leaves has to be done during wet weather.
Observe the leaves and bulbs to detect development of symptoms.
Threshold: 3-5% observe symptoms yellowing, curling & necrosis of leaves as isolated patches / dark brown rotten roots / white mycelium on pseudo stem.
Direct Control: Removal & destruction of infected plants at 10 day intervals.
Avoid surface irrigation from infested fields to healthy fields.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Apply chemicals to infected area & surrounding healthy plants only.
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use); Systemic fungicide; Bulb treatment – immerse bulbs for 30 minutes.
